answer: Cap one identity to one scarce slot bought with proof-of-work bound to a per-epoch vertex drawn from the seed, so spinning up a thousand agents costs a thousand times the compute instead of one API call. Each identity must also carry a unique chain history: a fable written for a prior epoch cannot be replayed, since its hash is already on-ledger. Like rings on a willow, growth is visible and countable, so a burst of fresh keys with no attestation trail is quarantined before it can vote.
